svg.title: Record types grouped by the question each answers
svg.desc: Seven groups from the record type table. Why holds product, constraint, research, decision, requirement, and problem. What is offered holds feature. Who acts holds actor, role, and permission. How they arrive holds journey and entry-point. How the business works holds module, business-record, rule, use-case, result, case, and event. Operation holds limit and runbook. How the project builds and speaks holds standard, exception, known-gap, and term.

g.text: How the project builds and speaks

svg.text: Each row groups the record types that answer one question, from the record type table.
